convert-ffi.title: convert-ffi
convert-ffi.description: A full-stack Leptos app for turning local audio files into a Spotify playlist. The browser reads the file tags, Rust calls a native Zig Spotify client through FFI, and the user reviews the matches before creating the playlist.

spotify-next-track.title: Infinite Playlist
spotify-next-track.description: An endless playlist generated from a song or Spotify playlist. A next-track model trained in the spotify-next-track Lensing project runs in the browser and picks each new song from my listening library.

convert-invert-site.title: Convert Invert Site
convert-invert-site.description: A complete web interface and service layer for operating Convert Invert from a browser. The project explores a Zig-based backend, worker orchestration, authentication, and an observable deployment stack.

app.title: Pathfinder
app.description: An interactive 3D visualization of the musical path between two Spotify tracks. A Rust and WebAssembly routing core finds a journey through listening taste while Cloudflare Workers serves search, previews, and the browser experience.

lvv.title: LVV
lvv.description: A Rust library for converting arbitrary structured data into vector embeddings. It supports configurable transformations, including LLM-assisted preprocessing, before data enters an embedding or retrieval pipeline.

craig.title: Craig
craig.description: A retrieval-augmented assistant designed for chemistry questions. It combines domain-specific source material with semantic retrieval so answers can be grounded in relevant scientific context.

glotaran_converter_lib.title: Glotaran Converter Library
glotaran_converter_lib.description: A Rust library that converts time-resolved fluorescence and laser flash photolysis measurements into Glotaran-compatible datasets. It encodes laboratory-specific parsing and preprocessing into a repeatable workflow.

glotaran_converter_cli.title: Glotaran Converter CLI
glotaran_converter_cli.description: A command-line interface for the Glotaran conversion library, providing an ergonomic way to transform fluorescence and laser flash photolysis files without writing Rust code.

agilent_ir.title: Agilent IR Parsers
agilent_ir.description: Tools for working with spectra exported by an Agilent Cary 660 ATR-IR instrument. They parse the instrument output and reconstruct the missing wavenumber axis so measurements are ready for analysis.

bilinear.title: Bilinear Calibration
bilinear.description: A Rust implementation of a published bilinear calibration method for chemical analysis. The project translates the numerical procedure described in DOI 10.1021/j100346a034 into reusable scientific software.

xrd_match.title: XRD Match
xrd_match.description: A notebook workflow for comparing experimental X-ray diffraction patterns with structures from a CIF database. It supports the identification and exploration of candidate crystalline materials.

MOFSocialNet.jl.title: MOFSocialNet.jl
MOFSocialNet.jl.description: A Julia and notebook-based reproduction of the MOFSocialNet method described by Jalali and collaborators. It explores graph-inspired analysis of metal-organic frameworks from structural data.

egonik-site.title: egonik-site
egonik-site.description: A database-backed personal site built as a full-stack Rust application. Leptos handles server rendering and browser hydration, Actix serves the application, and Diesel loads portfolio and publication data from Postgres.

gases.title: Molecular Dynamics of Gases
gases.description: An educational molecular-dynamics simulation of a gas written in Julia. It explores particle interactions and time evolution while serving as a compact scientific-computing exercise.

PHcalc.jl.title: PHcalc.jl
PHcalc.jl.description: A Julia implementation of Ryan Nelson's pHcalc library for calculating acid-base equilibria and solution pH. It brings an established chemistry workflow into the Julia ecosystem.

toy-server.title: toy-server
toy-server.description: A small HTTP server written directly on top of Rust's TcpListener. It parses request lines and headers, routes paths to handlers, and writes HTTP responses without using a web framework.

remote_listener.title: Remote Listener
remote_listener.description: A small Rust automation daemon that polls a URL and launches a configured local task when the remote service reports success. It is designed as a lightweight bridge between remote state and local execution.

dump_ps.title: Process Snapshot Logger
dump_ps.description: A Zig utility that captures process-list snapshots and persists them to a database, making it possible to inspect how machine activity changes over time.

rllm.title: RLLM
rllm.description: A work-in-progress Rust tool for selecting and consolidating codebase content into context suitable for language models. It focuses on making large Rust projects easier to inspect and share as text.

flagen.title: Flagen
flagen.description: A recreational generative-art program written in OCaml. It uses Monte Carlo-style processes to build visual compositions from repeated randomized decisions.

demoLogits.title: LLM Sampling Visualizer
demoLogits.description: An interactive demonstration that makes language-model sampling visible. Each generated token is animated as a choice among top-logprob candidates, turning an abstract probability distribution into an intuitive visual sequence.

demoCodex.title: Calorimetry Curve Demo
demoCodex.description: An interactive teaching tool for estimating the corrected temperature change in neutralization calorimetry curves. It presents the fitting process visually so experimental corrections are easier to understand.
